headline: Guinea Ratifies $336 Million Loan to Pave Labé-Tougué Highway
summary: Guinea's government ratified a $336 million road financing facility arranged by a Bank of Africa syndicate to pave 160 kilometers connecting Labé and Tougué.
why: Infrastructure loans in mineral-rich West African nations are critical for unlocking logistics corridors and mining concession access.

impacts.name: Guinea
impacts.why: Loan proceeds finance essential regional transport corridors to improve domestic commerce.
